player_intent: One PS1 character supports Mixamo and retargeted AGLS animation with deforming fingers.
acceptance_rule: Canonical player and fallback loader use the 65-bone authored asset; original body and wrist rests remain within 1mm and 0.1 degrees; all new finger segments have mesh weights; both source clips animate through the runtime adapter; canonical animation and movement pass. Weapon-pose failures must be compared against the untouched original rig and no new failures accepted.

nodes.role: Shared authored rig and weighted character mesh

visual_check: Inspect native Mixamo gameplay with attached weapon and five AGLS reload samples, checking fingers, shoulders, torso and feet. Per-clip contact tuning remains separate from rig compatibility.

system_delta.reason: Retain the existing dual-source adapter and native joints; replace unweighted finger placeholders with authored spaced chains and glove geometry. Use the same asset in the canonical player and fallback loader; key cache by target asset hash.
